correctness.rationale: The result concerns unlooped T_n=L(K_n), with either color allowed to force. At n=3 the empty set stalls and every nonempty set fills all vertices. At n=4, the three complementary pairs in K_4 give the parallel classes of the rank-two primal matroid; the complementary four-sets are all dual circuits and precisely the open neighborhoods. At n=6 the even-weight dot-product space has radical generated by the all-one vector; after quotienting it is nondegenerate alternating of dimension four. The 15 two-label classes are distinct (a sum of two weight-two vectors cannot be the all-one vector), and the open neighborhoods are the complements of all 15 hyperplanes, precisely the circuits of the dual projective geometry. Consequently the forcing rule and matroid circuit-closure rule agree for every initial subset. The dual rank is 11 and the basis count is 15·14·12·8/24=840. For the negative cases, I independently obtained remaining white sets (W, empty, {23,24,34}) at n=5 and (W, empty, {01,02,12}) at n=7 in the order original, after x, after y. Each stalled triangle has two internal neighbors at each white edge, and any exterior pair meets at least two triangle edges or none. For n≥8 the two centers of the spanning double star have degree at least four and all leaves have degree one, so the unfilled-neighbor count of each pair is never one. Filling x makes label 2 isolated in the white graph; the pair 2v exposes each remaining leaf edge at leaf v, then the center edge is exposed. Filling y instead leaves disjoint stars with at least three leaves each, still stalled, including x. This proves all orders, not just those checked. An independent four-coordinate quotient-span check agreed with graph closure for all 8, 64 and 32768 subsets at n=3,4,6 respectively.

value.rationale: This is a complete classification of when the skew rule on a standard family of line graphs gives an exchange operator. The corank-four projective exception explains the exceptional size structurally, not by isolated exhaustive search; the two exceptional-order witnesses and uniform spanning double star explain exactly where exchange breaks. The claim is stronger than re-counting bases of an already given projective geometry or listing the known corank-two cases.
